product.description: A tool to create custom internal apps quickly using text commands and AI, without requiring developer skills or coding.

product.description: A native OCR tool that extracts and organizes data from images and PDFs into structured tables, eliminating manual data entry.

product.description: A suite of customizable tools including Kanban boards, SLAs, tables, forms, and dashboards to manage internal business processes.

product.description: Over 370 pre-built automations and integrations plus support for custom automations via low-code and APIs to automate manual business tasks.

product.description: Allows full branding customization of apps and forms with company logos and colors, including custom domains and subdomains for client access.
